Rock audio + copper guidance - 2026-10-29

Audio is an explicit owner delivery; does not close broader audio issues.

Rock fall WAV sources, each 0.8865s / stereo / 48kHz, originals untouched:

FFmpeg 7.1: average stereo channels to mono, normalise mono peak to .8,
3ms start / 5ms end fades, Opus/Ogg and MP3 at 48kbps. Base rock-impact file
replaced with take 1; -2/-3 files added for the other alternatives.
Each rockLand plays exactly one alternative; alternatives are not layers.
Event hash gives stable pseudorandom choices without consuming simulation RNG.
All variations share one four-voice cap and the existing effects bus; simultaneous
landings are not discarded by the ordinary 30ms same-id retrigger guard.

The sample loader discovers variants and recognises a changed loader revision
during HMR, discarding stale deliveries and ignoring obsolete async results.
Normal updates take the O(1) revision fast path. Music stream, event cursor and
State remain intact, so old events never replay during a code hot swap.

#167 requested: subtle, sporadic green cubic particles pointing toward Beacon,
without a continuous evenly spaced dotted line. Implemented as 3 bounded lanes,
irregular deterministic birth windows/gaps, short .6-.95s lifetimes, lateral
scatter, gentle drift and smooth fades capped at alpha .2. Small shaded cube
faces are native pixel rectangles (no circles, blur or hard flashing). Positions
follow the existing walkable Beacon route; walls and foreground art clip them.
Quality thins the secondary lanes; mineral/energy/phase gating stays unchanged.
The escape wisp is separate and untouched. No new State fields or image art.

Verification:
- Full npm run check and build pass; 34 audio files fit unchanged budgets.
- Pure random-choice/distribution, route/RNG/gating and sparse-pattern checks.
- Real one-shot engine fake verifies chosen buffer identity, one node per impact,
  all three variants and simultaneous-event common cap (no synth fallback).
- Actual browser: 30 fall events select takes 1/2/3 11/11/8 times. All durations
  .8865s; four simultaneous voices, one source per event. MP3 fallback decodes
  all three. Code HMR preserves buffer map/music and does not replay events.
- Stale delivery simulation reloads the correct supplied sample successfully.
- Copper preview over 600 frames (60s): 343 quiet frames, mean .525 visible
  cubes, maximum 3, 43 sideways positions, 0 arcs/circles. Wall barrier clips
  175 of 315 cues; low quality draws 91 instead of 315. Frozen clock pixels
  repeat exactly; render does not mutate State. Torch off/other mineral/escape
  suppress hints. Browser consoles have no errors or warnings.
